items.title: Hackers Steal About $2.7 Million From Polymarket Traders via Hijacked DebugBear Script
items.summary: Malicious code on the website of prediction market Polymarket sold some signed-in traders' positions and moved their funds to the hackers on October 29. The code had replaced a page-speed script that the site loaded from an outside company. Polymarket says it is refunding about $2.7 million to 726 affected wallets.

items.title: CVE-2026-120197: A flaw has been found in WAVLINK WL-WN530HG4B M_V260724.
items.summary: A flaw has been found in WAVLINK WL-WN530HG4B M_V260724. This impacts the function port_forward of the file /cgi-bin/wapi.cgi.
